```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"A thorough political and social revolution in this country is necessary to assure that Black and Brown lives matter.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America’s working class is suffering the severe pain of this pandemic.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Black and Brown working class America has been absolutely devastated by COVID-19.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Supporting the Breathe Act would mean reinvestment in Black and brown communities and a divestment from policing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Had the Breathe Act been in place, Walter Wallace may have gotten the care he deserved rather than death at the hands of the police.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Politicians who claim to care about the working class must support the Emergency Health Guarantee Act and Medicare for All because quality healthcare is a human right.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Politicians who claim to care about the working class must open up and rebuild hospitals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Politicians who claim to care about the working class must support full restoration of public schools.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Politicians who claim to care about the working class must guarantee good jobs, safe working conditions, and the ability to organize.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The needs of everyone are uplifted, but these are essential for the uplift, preservation, and liberation of Black and Brown Life.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
